verdict.rationale: Gaming performance is a fair axis for a high-end GPU, but the pack has no vendor 4K gaming frame-rate claims and no independent game benchmarks. Display-output specs (DisplayPort 2.1 up to 8K at 240Hz), DLSS 4 and RT Core claims are framed around professional rendering and game development, which is adjacent to the story rather than evidence of high-refresh 4K gaming. Community items cover AI inference builds and hardware defects, not gaming.
